heroHeadline: Quiet week across every front; backfill surfaces NALSAR's Sep 1 solidarity statement for NLSIU's graduating class
heroSubtitle: No new flashpoints emerged in the review window: the Jharkhand BJP's four-day statewide siege of DC/SP offices ran its full course through Sep 11 across all 24 districts without a government CBI-probe concession, and the CJP/CJP-Democratic split, Bihar's TRE-4 notification and the Jamia admissions dispute remain unchanged since their early-September developments. Backfill review surfaced one previously untracked item: NALSAR University's Student Bar Council issued a Sep 1 statement backing NLSIU Bengaluru's Batch of 2026 over its cancelled convocation, calling it 'concerning' that graduates were reportedly asked to publicly re-invite Chief Justice Surya Kant. Separately, the Sep 1 Supreme Court order quashing NEET-protester FIRs carries a 90-day deadline (~Dec 1) for the Centre's compensation policy and a November deadline for a national task force report, both still pending.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
